data.standardized_narrative: In 2019, Syndicate 1200 experienced an overall gross reserve strengthening of GBP 36.3 million, representing 4.73% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by large losses and increased attritional losses on the 2017 and prior underwriting years, as well as large loss activity on the 2018 year of account. The syndicate reassessed its initial expected loss ratios and added an extra layer of caution to its loss picks, reflecting execution risk and deterioration from expected loss ratios in short tail lines (US Direct and Facultative, Cargo, Yachts & Hull, UK SME, Onshore energy) and large loss notifications on long tail lines (Casualty). Specific events impacting prior years included Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, California wildfires, and Mexico earthquakes in 2017, and Hurricanes Florence & Michael, California wildfires, and large losses in Marine Onshore Energy, Hull and Asia in 2018.

data.data_quality_notes: The explicit prior year development figure of GBP 36.3m from narrative text on page 17 is used. This figure differs from a calculation based on the gross claims development triangle on page 18, which suggests a strengthening of approximately GBP 111.7m for underwriting years 2013-2017. The narrative statement is considered more direct for the overall prior year development.
